items.title: OPEC+ Faces Growing Pressure As Iraq Pushes for Higher Quota
items.summary: Iraq is negotiating with OPEC for permission to produce more oil, Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair said Friday, arguing that the country needs a higher production ceiling to develop its energy infrastructure. items.summary: The U.S. Administration early this year encouraged two of OPEC’s five founding members, Iraq and Venezuela, to leave the cartel, Reuters reported on Friday, quoting multiple sources with knowledge of the matter. items.title: Hormuz Tanker Traffic Rises This Month Even as Attacks Increase
items.summary: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has risen this month, according to data from Vortexa, even as attacks on vessels in the contested waterway have increased.

items.title: Italy Rebukes Ukraine Over Attacks on Russian Ships in Libya
items.summary: Italy has told Ukraine it was wrong to attack Russian ships in Libyan waters and warned Kyiv not to spread the war to new areas, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani told Corriere della Sera newspaper on Wednesday.
